text:
maria: Quick question — how do we want fallthrough to behave when a private deployment doesn't have the requested quantized model (e.g., q4_0) but hosted does?
jon: Are we talking about automatic routing to hosted, or returning an explicit error for operator decision?
maria: Automatic routing is tempting for availability, but I'm worried about data residency and KMS differences. we can't silently send private customer traffic to hosted without consent.
akira: +1 on consent. We also need to preserve latency SLOs — fallback to hosted might blow P99. Maybe allow policy-driven fallthrough.
tess: Proposed policy knobs: `allow_network_fallback` (bool), `fallback_tier` (hosted|dedicated|none), `require_audit_header` (bool). Keep defaults conservative.
maria: Example config idea:```yaml
deployment:
  mode: private
  fallthrough:
    allow_network_fallback: false
    fallback_tier: none
    require_audit_header: true
```
jon: If `allow_network_fallback=true` we should inject a synthetic audit header and mark tokens as crossed-boundary so billing and telemetry can split correctly. We also need to propagate KMS wrap metadata.
akira: Operational note: when routed to hosted we must degrade model variant gracefully, e.g., pick nearest compatible quantization (q8->q4 fallback) or a smaller sequence length to avoid OOM. Document the variant selection priority: quant->arch->ortho.
maria: Can we add a neutral "probe" step before fallback? like attempt a lightweight probe to hosted variant and only route full request on success. reduces noisy failures.
tess: probe idea sounds good. Probe should be ip-restricted and rate-limited. Also needs idempotency and no-cache semantics.
sre-bot: deploy-preview: fallthrough-policy v0.1 pushed to staging (link: https://ci/redwood/11337) :rocket:
jon: Dev question — where does translation live? control-plane translates customer manifest -> runtime hints, right? so policy enforcement should be in the adapter layer.
akira: Yes. Control plane annotates request with `__fallthrough_policy` header, adapter enforces and logs decision. Adapter must be explicit when crossing tenancy boundaries.
maria: Logging requirements: if fallback happens, emit `fallback_reason`, `chosen_tier`, `probe_latency_ms`, `kms_key_ring` (if different). Those fields should be searchable in Console.
tess: Also add a quality signal: `model_variant_delta` (e.g., q4_0->q8_0) so Optimize can surface regressions.
jon: Action items:
- maria: draft policy YAML and edge-case matrix (private->hosted, private->dedicated, dedicated->hosted) — due EOD Thursday
- tess: add probe flow PR with rate-limits and audit header injection — start Monday
- akira: adapter logging spec + telemetry mapping for Console — sync Wed
- infra: @sre-bot please run staging perf test for fallback probe path (P99/95)
maria: thanks. i'll post the draft in #product-apis when ready. @jon @akira @tess flag anything missing. :+1:
jon: One more: add legal/sa review for default `allow_network_fallback=true`. We should assume false by default.
maria: Agreed. Closing loop after legal ok then bake into default manifest.
